I am an old woman with many seasons behind me. My bones are not strong enough for the heavy work anymore, but my children and grandchildren help me on this land. For this rice plot, I will do what I have always done—use the manure from our animals to feed the soil, and plant the rice seed we have saved from last season. I do not have money for chemical fertilizer or those new seeds from the shop, and the rains here in Ruvuma have always been enough without irrigation.
